items.text: Edward Jones states its strategic ambition is to help tens of millions of investors achieve financial fulfillment through personalized, comprehensive planning and trusted advice, and that to do so it aspires to continue investing in technology to scale financial planning, to anticipate clients' needs with the right offering at the right time now and for generations to come, and to attract and serve new client segments.
items.quote: The Partnership's strategic ambition is to help tens of millions of investors achieve financial fulfillment through personalized, comprehensive planning and trusted advice. To do this, the Partnership aspires to: • Continue investing in technology to scale our ability to provide financial planning to our clients • Anticipate clients' needs with the right offering at the right time, now and for generations to come • Attract and serve new client segments

items.text: Edward Jones states that among its initiatives to target new clients is a new digital platform focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models; Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones states it seeks to address its strategic risks, most notably competition for clients and personnel in light of the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, changing client demographics, preferences and values, through its initiatives to deliver enhanced value and impact for millions of current and potential clients, and is continuing to make significant investments to attract and retain qualified talent.
